skill.name: wasmc-std
skill.description: Typed standard resources, collections, encoding, signed integer text and structured records with explicit ownership. All collection, byte, label and key capacities follow aggregate runtime memory.

apis.delta: Preserve the declared WIT operation and resource ownership through ordinary Rust business logic and complete Core/Component views.
apis.ecosystem: Rust standard library and exact cohort ecosystem dependencies
